name: message-actions-overflow
description: Keep message actions to three inline actions and expose the rest through one overflow menu

metadata.name: message-actions-overflow
metadata.description: Keep message actions to three inline actions and expose the rest through one overflow menu

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const tabs=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^=\"tab-\"]')).filter(el=>{const id=el.getAttribute('data-testid')||'';return id!=='tab-bar'&&id!=='tab-bar-new'&&!id.startsWith('tab-group-')&&!id.startsWith('tab-rename-input-');}); let ok=false; for(const tab of tabs){tab.click();await sleep(350);const toggle=document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"workspace-toggle-view\"]');if(toggle instanceof HTMLElement){toggle.click();await sleep(500);if(document.querySelector('[data-testid^=\"messages-pane-\"]')){ok=true;break;}}} document.body.setAttribute('data-bas-actions-active',ok?'true':'false');})()

(() => { const cards=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^=\"msg-card-\"]')); const bounded=cards.length>0&&cards.every(card=>card.querySelectorAll('[data-message-action-inline]:not([data-testid^=\"msg-actions-more-\"])').length<=3); const targets=cards.flatMap(card=>Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('[data-message-action-inline]'))); const sized=targets.length>0&&targets.every(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return r.width>=44&&r.height>=44;}); const more=document.querySelector('[data-testid^=\"msg-actions-more-\"]'); if(more instanceof HTMLElement) more.click(); document.body.setAttribute('data-bas-actions-bounded',bounded&&sized&&!!more?'true':'false');})()
